name: instploy
description: Connect Cursor to InstPloy MCP. On install, set your MCP URL and Bearer token (or run /connect-instploy and paste your JSON).

INSTPLOY_URL.title: url
INSTPLOY_URL.description: InstPloy MCP URL from your config, e.g. https://YOUR_INSTANCE.instploy.com/instploy/manager/mcp

INSTPLOY_TOKEN.title: Authorization Bearer token
INSTPLOY_TOKEN.description: Token only (without the word Bearer). From headers.Authorization in your InstPloy MCP JSON.
